about_the_game:
28 days ago, you got the call - your brother’s checkpoint had fallen. Now it’s surrounded by the dead.

He’s not like you. He’s a scientist, chasing a cure.

You’ve spent your life as a cop - fighting, surviving.

Now, to save him, you’ll need a reinforced ride and a plan to hand your own checkpoint over to the U.S. Army.

You’re the last surviving soldier at the only checkpoint still standing in the north of the city.
Your mission: save as many uninfected civilians as you can. If you let the infected slip out of Chicago, the entire world could fall. Hold the line. Buy more weapons and upgrade your defenses. The Army promises to arrive in 30 days - then comes the raid. You’ll fight your way through the ruins of Chicago to reach your brother… and try to save him at any cost.

Make cold, calculated decisions.

Every survivor has a story - and they’ll tell it to you. But don’t believe everything you hear. Inspect each one carefully and decide their fate.
Will you let them pass? Hold them for a second screening? Or are they too far gone - and need to be eliminated?
The choice is yours.

Gameplay

First-person gameplay that blends inspection sim and zombie action.

Screen refugees with a full-body scanner and other tools to detect signs of infection.

Decide each refugee’s fate: clear them to leave Chicago, hold them in a quarantine room for observation, or eliminate them.

Head out from the base to clear infested zones.

Earn cash to buy weapons and repair your car for the toughest raid across a ruined Chicago.

Tools

Use special gear to find out if a survivor is infected or smuggling contraband. Personal inspections, scanners, and a range of devices will help you.
So will a good shotgun.

Zombies

Zombie waves grow stronger by the day. Crawlers, Spitters, Aggressors, Marine Zombies… A good shotgun helps. But not always.

Preparing for the Raid

Repair your car and get it ready for the brutal run through Chicago to your brother’s checkpoint.
Save him—no matter the cost.

short_description: Inspect survivors in Chicago’s Quarantine Zone to spot the infected before they turn. No base-building - just tense inspections and gunfights! You’ve got 30 days until the army arrives. Hold out, fix your car, and fight your way through Chicago to the main checkpoint to save your little brother.
